items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: He had O'Reilly and Lil' George Mitchell on the carnet.

ctx.x: Yeah. And she fell off the pen and dead and heart attack. So I attribute that to her grieving. She never forget him. And I did have a little hassle on her. This tune strutting with some barbecue. I understand she said it was his and she said it was hers. Well you know Lil was a very good musician. You see she graduated from some college down in Tennessee. I don't know if it was Fisk or what anyhow. She even went with her job.
